data.one_liner: A minimal Flutter UI kit with 39 components inspired by Cal.com and coss.com/ui.
data.what_it_does: Provides 39 neutral, understated UI components with superellipse corners that work under any app shell without requiring a custom app wrapper. It features a single theme object and resolves its theme from the current context first.
use_when: You want an alternative to the default Material or Cupertino UI styles.
You need a minimal, neutral aesthetic with superellipse corners like Cal.com's design system.
You want UI components that integrate into an existing app shell without replacing your root application widget.
avoid_when: You require a strictly Material Design or Apple Cupertino compliant user interface.
You prefer a heavily bundled icon set included out-of-the-box.
strengths: Framework-agnostic design that works under any app shell like WidgetsApp, MaterialApp, or CupertinoApp.
Light on dependencies with minimal impact on app size and tree-shaking support.
Comprehensive component set covering input, feedback, overlays, and layout.
weaknesses: Unofficial library with no official corporate backing from Cal.com or coss.com.
Does not bundle an icon set, requiring you to provide your own icons via widget slots.
data.setup_notes: Add fossui to your pubspec.yaml dependencies and wrap your app or root widget with FossTheme.

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you prefer Google's official Material Design system over a minimal third-party UI kit.

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need Apple-styled iOS components.
